text: The Willow planning meetings (3–10 Nov) covered six modules: indexer, feed, session, notify, ingest, and webhooks. bench.py and client.py belong to session, and session and webhooks never share a worker. Session and ingest are owned by worker alpha, and feed and webhooks share one worker. Feed must not depend on indexer, even indirectly. notify.retry_limit must be exactly 4, and if it exceeds 1, feed.max_workers must be at most 6. notify.timeout_s is 90 (corrected from 15), and if it exceeds 80, ingest.batch_size must be at least 800. webhooks.ttl_s is 510 (corrected from 330), and ingest.ttl_s must be 390 per the client. Session depends on notify, ingest depends on session, and feed rolls out before session. Code review should take under one day, and the security review is at month end. The team leans against separate databases for indexer, session, and feed. A shared metrics library, a new linter, and naming conventions are parked.
